ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, several shapes are pieced together into a figure whose outer outline is a regular octagon. It can be seen that the top gray rhombus has one vertex located exactly at the topmost vertex of the regular octagon, and the two rhombus sides adjacent to this vertex respectively coincide with the two outer sides of the regular octagon that intersect there. In the figure there are also four identical rhombuses and two squares pieced together. Reasoning: Each interior angle of a regular octagon is (8-2)×180°÷8 = 1080°÷8 = 135°. The angle of the top gray rhombus at the topmost vertex is exactly the interior angle of the regular octagon at that vertex, so the obtuse angle of this rhombus is 135°. Since the four rhombuses are completely identical, the obtuse angles of all the rhombuses are 135°.

raw_record.question_text: Four identical rhombuses (diamonds) and two squares are fitted together to form a regular octagon as shown. How big are the obtuse interior angles in the rhombuses?

method.method_draft: From the image, first identify the outer boundary as a regular octagon and note that the top gray rhombus has its top vertex exactly at a vertex of the octagon, with its two adjacent sides lying along the two outer octagon sides meeting there. From the text, use that the whole figure is a regular octagon and the gray diamonds are identical rhombuses. Compute the interior angle of a regular octagon: (8-2)·180°/8 = 135°. Since the rhombus angle at that shared outer vertex is the same angle as the octagon’s interior angle, that rhombus has an obtuse angle of 135°. Because all four rhombuses are identical, the obtuse interior angles in every rhombus are 135°.

推理：正八边形的每个内角为 (8-2)×180°÷8 = 1080°÷8 = 135°。顶部灰色菱形在最上方顶点处的角，正好就是正八边形在该顶点处的内角，因此这个菱形的钝角是 135°。由于四个菱形完全相同，所以所有菱形的钝角都为 135°。
